newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thai Oil refinery maintenance ends, plans for July.
newsitem.headline: Thai Oil refinery maintenance ends, plans for July.

text.p: Refiner Thai Oil Co Ltd's 50,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) has returned from its 18-day maintenance shutdown, a company source said on Tuesday.
The source said the CDU No.2. returned to full capacity on November 18.
He said the next scheduled maintenance shutdown will involve the refinery's largest CDU No.3 with a capacity of 14,000 tonnes-per-day (104,000 bpd) for the first three weeks in July 1997.

The 220,000-bpd refinery, which is located at Sri Racha on the eastern seabord, is owned by state-owned Petroleum Authority of Thailand (49 percent), Anglo-Dutch Shell (15 percent)and Caltex the U.S. joint-venture between Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp (4.75 percent). The remaining 31.2 percent is owned by private investors.
